description: Spring Modulith API provides the core, runtime-retained annotations used to declare and describe application modules in a Spring Boot application, such as @Modulith, @Modulithic, @ApplicationModule, and @NamedInterface for naming modules, customizing module metadata, and marking named interfaces. It also defines the ApplicationModuleInitializer callback interface for module-ordered startup logic, letting application code depend on these lightweight module-definition contracts without pulling in the full structural-analysis engine from spring-modulith-core.
